latestReport.title: MTG Market Movers — 2026-10-16
executiveSummary: Reality Fracture is the dominant catalyst in the dated evidence. TCGplayer reports Standard-driven movement in The Theorist, Jace Beleren, Abstergo Entertainment, Haliya, and related cards, while TCGIndex describes a neutral broader market, with 52% of tracked cards advancing and The Theorist, Jace Beleren as its largest mover. The sources do not agree on every current price; these signals remain developing rather than confirmed.

Commander demand is also reported for Tivit, Seller of Secrets and Ripples of Potential. Both remain watch cases exposed to thin supply, reprint risk, and deck-specific demand. A large reported percentage move is not proof of durable adoption.

Wizards’ product calendar adds a supply context: Foundations Commander decks released on October 2; Mystery Booster Commander Edition is scheduled for MagicCon Atlanta on November 13–15; Festival in a Box: Atlanta goes on sale October 19. These are potential supply and collector-demand catalysts, not automatic buy signals.
whatChanged: The lead lens shifted from a single spoiler spike toward Reality Fracture Standard adoption and related planeswalker demand.
The Theorist, Jace Beleren is reported at $63.41 by TCGplayer and approximately $82.26 by TCGIndex; exact printing and venue reconciliation remain necessary.
Abstergo Entertainment and Ripples of Potential were reported to have doubled from approximately $2 to $4 and $3 to $6, respectively.

Tivit, Seller of Secrets was reported to move from a long-held $4–$5 range toward $15 after a popular EDH build; the report marks it Do Not Chase pending depth, completed sales, and persistent adoption.
Haliya, Guided by Light reached a reported high near $6, but the source did not provide a clean prior baseline; no percentage move is recorded.
No Prediction Review was due on October 16. All open reviews remain unresolved.

signalsToWatch.name: Tivit, Seller of Secrets
signalsToWatch.note: The report calls this a Do Not Chase case until listing depth, completed sales, and sustained deck adoption confirm the move.

signalsToWatch.name: Haliya, Guided by Light
signalsToWatch.note: Track as a Standard adoption watch, not a percentage mover; establish a verified price baseline and check tournament/decklist persistence.

supplyDesk: The report says Foundations Commander contains five ready-to-play monocolor decks and treats the release as a product/supply event—not evidence that every included single will appreciate.

Mystery Booster Commander Edition is described as a Commander Draft booster product, not a preconstructed deck. The report flags future-event distribution and the October 19 Festival in a Box sale as supply events.
doNotChase: Tivit, Seller of Secrets until listing depth, completed sales, and sustained deck adoption confirm the move.
Reality Fracture cards when source, treatment, or collector number cannot be reconciled.
Narrow combo or precon-single theses supported only by one decklist or one marketplace snapshot.
